TOGAWASAKIKO-OCEAN_OF_MEMORIES.title: Unfamiliar Place
TOGAWASAKIKO-OCEAN_OF_MEMORIES.pages.INI:
Sakiko opens her eyes in an unfamiliar place. A colossal, whale-like creature watches her through the blue haze.
"I‘m... Neow...  ..receive... this..."
TOGAWASAKIKO-OCEAN_OF_MEMORIES.pages.DON:
"Go... ..up... and.. seek.. for your... answer..."
Sakiko turns toward the tower.
